mapper.sql: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.role, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, u.client_id, c.client_name, u.status, u.create_time FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sys_client c ON u.client_id = c.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, role, phone, email, avatar, dept_id, client_id, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password, real_name, role, phone, email, avatar, dept_id, client_id, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, role, phone, email, avatar, dept_id, client_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{deptId}, #{clientId}, #{status}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE role = #{role}
